title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Item – ABC Analysis (Standard report)
summary: The Item - ABC Analysis standard report in Business Central 2026 wave 1 classifies inventory items into A, B, and C categories based on sales value to help prioritize stock management and purchasing decisions. The report supports inventory managers, purchasing agents, and controllers in identifying high-value items and optimizing inventory investment.
key_points: Items are ranked into categories based on sales amounts in local currency, with configurable percentage thresholds for each category
Category A items have high value and drive most revenue, Category B has medium value, and Category C has high volume but low value
The report includes Excel layout with print, structure, and analysis worksheets that support filtering and further data analysis
Thresholds can be set on the ABC Analysis Setup page and overridden per report run
Classifications are consistent with the ABC Analysis Power BI Report using the same threshold logic

quotes.text: Use the report to decide which items to always keep in stock and where you can afford occasional stock-outs.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the core business purpose of ABC analysis for optimizing inventory investment and resource allocation

quotes.text: The same thresholds are also used by the ABC Analysis (Power BI Report), so the classification is consistent across both reports.
quotes.why_it_matters: Ensures users understand that classifications are unified across reporting tools for consistency
